'''Milos Brejik''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] before the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet's]] [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3956 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which include the [[destruction of Taris]], to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> at the hands of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]]. The Tarisian became a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] after the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], using his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] skills to forage and recover supplies for the few scattered survivors. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the remains of an old swoop track became known as [[Brejik's Run]] in Brejik's honor.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Milos Brejik was mentioned in the Codex entry for Brejik's Run in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]'s [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
